info.description: Pre-implementation API contract. Not a running API or a provider contract. Cross-field validation, money, isolation, approvals and transaction invariants are normative in docs/26_api_permissions_events.md. Property operations use the session membership. Schemas may not accept tenant IDs from bodies.
